_meta.note: Prices are user-maintained. Only rows the project could verify against a first-party source are shipped; a model with no row here still gets full token accounting, its cost is simply reported as unknown. Add your own rows (or point ATS_MODEL_PRICES at your own file) to price the rest.
_meta.anthropic_source: Anthropic first-party API rates, cached 2026-06-24. Bedrock / Vertex are partner-operated with separate pricing.
_meta.keys: A key is matched against the model id after normalization (lowercased, provider prefix such as 'anthropic/' removed, ':free'-style suffix removed). Exact match wins; otherwise the longest key that is a prefix of the model id wins.
